references.text: David encourages proclaiming God's law, which can be seen as a parallel to preaching the message in the light.
The call to cry out loudly and hold nothing back resembles the instruction to preach from the rooftops.
Micah speaks of waiting for God's light, which relates to speaking in the light in Matthew.
The parable about the light and the city on a hill emphasizes the importance of being visible and open about one's faith, similar to the message of preaching from the rooftops.
Luke's version of not hiding what is said in darkness but declaring it in the light.
A similar theme as in Matthew about proclaiming what has been spoken in secret.
